_doc: Owner classes for v5-tenancykey-001 (V5-SPACETENANCYKEY-001, multi-space plan V204 step 2.1): who may own a row in each table that gains workspace_id.

Every SQL file of this directory refuses, changing nothing, if any distinct owner value of any row (soft-deleted included) of its table is not in the running env's section. The files embed this file: generate.mjs writes them and tenancykey.test.js holds them equal.

classes: match is 'exact' (value = owner), 'like' (owner LIKE value; every _ is escaped as \_ because LIKE reads a bare _ as any one character) or 'null' (owner IS NULL). envs lists the sections a class is in; tables, when given, limits it to those tables.

tables: one SQL file per row, in order (n). owner names the column(s) read; parent names a join where the table has no owner column. fkOnly: the table already has workspace_id; the file adds the key only and its guard is that every row names a Space.
fingerprint: a schema_version stamp only that env carries, and one only the other env carries. A file run with the wrong -v env on a database refuses.
Built from a read-only census of prod and staging, 2026-10-20 ~14:00Z (lane log lanes-p2/2.1.log). The sitting's step 0 re-runs it (README.md, 'Sitting').

They belong on CI's throwaway branches of staging; a leak onto staging itself (BUG-INTFIXTURELEAK-001) carries this marker. Never prod. None on staging today.

tables.note: space_id stays the attachment parent; workspace_id is the row's Space.

parent.label: garden_node_id->plants.created_by
parent.from: public.findings t LEFT JOIN public.plants p ON p.id = t.garden_node_id

tables.note: No owner column: a finding is its planting's (garden_node_id NOT NULL, FK plants ON DELETE RESTRICT).
No created_by: actor is who ran the rescope.

auditWatch.reason: v5-sourceentity-001 post_audit_update_watches_every_mutable_column requires every source column but id, match_key and updated_at in this trigger's watched list, so that no column is editable without history. workspace_id is mutable (a later Space move writes it), so it is watched, as v5-sourcecontact-001 did for its two columns. Re-created in the same transaction as the column, behind a definition pre-gate: the md5 of the trigger's catalog fingerprint (type, enabled, function, transition tables, arguments) read on prod and staging 2026-10-20.

parent.label: target->created_by
parent.from: public.slug_redirects t LEFT JOIN public.plant_projects pp ON t.target_entity_type = 'project' AND pp.id = t.target_entity_id LEFT JOIN public.plant_varieties pv ON t.target_entity_type = 'variety' AND pv.id = t.target_entity_id LEFT JOIN public.plants g ON t.target_entity_type = 'planting' AND g.id = t.target_entity_id
parent.value: CASE t.target_entity_type WHEN 'project' THEN pp.created_by WHEN 'variety' THEN pv.created_by WHEN 'planting' THEN g.created_by END

tables.note: No owner column: a redirect is its target's (target_entity_type project, variety or planting). An 'archived' target or a missing target has no owner and refuses.
